summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade unless the faculty director grants an exception, toward the 27 units the minor needs. The audit checks the foundational course, 3 units of experiential inter-arts courses (ARTSINST 12AX needs 20AX to reach them), and the capstone: ARTSINST 200A-C for 6 units, or ARTSINST 201A-C for at least two units each. On the 201 option, receiving Honors in the Arts as well takes 6 more units the faculty director approves. The capstone courses do not also count as electives. You move in the 13 units of electives the faculty director approves (from at least two departments) and check the capstone proposal by hand.

program.why: Grading: "Courses used to satisfy all units taken for the minor must be taken for a letter grade, though the faculty director may grant exceptions in extenuating circumstances."

XCSxJdM7-text.why: "To earn a Minor in Interdisciplinary Arts, students must complete at least 27 units of coursework in the program and a senior capstone project. Required coursework includes a foundational class in interdisciplinary methods, an experiential arts course, and 13-15 units of electives". An overview of the rules below: the 27 units are the program minimum, the study plan and capstone proposal approval is rule U7fPk5Wc, and the capstone options are the Capstone Courses rule. Declaring by senior autumn and finishing coursework before the workshop series are timing the audit does not track; the 6 extra units for also taking Honors in the Arts belong to that combination, not to the minor alone.

i3dM4XxZ.why: "For a total of 3-4 units, students can choose from the courses listed below (note that ARTSINST 12AX must be taken with ARTSINST 20AX to reach a total of 3 units)." Faculty Director-approved alternatives are moved in by hand.

6aEcjndO.why: "The remaining 13-15 units of the 27-unit minor must be satisfied by elective courses from at least two departments ... All electives must be approved by the Faculty Director." The 27 units are the Bulletin's program minimum, which the audit checks.

U7fPk5Wc.why: "Students must also complete a Capstone Proposal in Spring Quarter of their junior year. Both the Study Plan and Capstone Proposal must receive approval by the Faculty Director."

JdIsEziI.why: "within the senior workshop series (ARTSINST 200A, B & C) for two units per quarter, for a total of 6 units." The capstone is coursework of its own within the 27 units, so the block does not share its courses.

GE3x2dLf.why: "within the senior honors workshop series (ARTSINST 201A, B & C) for a minimum of two units per quarter. Students who pursue this option and wish to receive the IHN "Honors in the Arts" in addition to the Inter-Arts Minor degree must also complete 6 additional units of coursework, to be approved by the faculty director." The overview says the same: "must also complete 6 additional units of coursework, to be approved by the Faculty Director, in order to satisfy the requirements of both programs." A student on this option who does not take the honors designation marks the extra units done.

children.name: 6 additional units approved by the faculty director, when you also receive Honors in the Arts
